description: Section 9A.6: why a SessionEvidenceRecord does not verify. Each case is one complete, sealed record that fails exactly one check, built by this implementation's generator from a test session, edited as the case says, and resealed with the producer's test-only key. Verify it with the did_documents of the base it names; both implementations must refuse it and give expected_reason as verify_session_evidence_record_reason / verifySessionEvidenceRecordReason. Together the cases reach every reason code a verifier can return.

cases.name: malformed_record
cases.description: The record carries no acts member.

cases.name: unrecognized_record_type
cases.description: record_type is not a SessionEvidenceRecord's.

cases.name: unrecognized_record_version
cases.description: record_version names no published version.

cases.name: decline_vocabulary_version
cases.description: A record carrying a rejection or withdrawal signature is labelled below 0.4.

cases.name: external_commitment_version
cases.description: A 0.3 record must carry external_commitment_reference.

cases.name: terminal_outcome_invalid
cases.description: terminal.outcome is not a terminal outcome.

cases.name: generated_at_mismatch
cases.description: generated_at differs from terminal.timestamp.

cases.name: completion_witness_invalid
cases.description: A record that did not complete carries a transaction_record_hash.

cases.name: producer_method_not_controlled
cases.description: producer.verification_method is not under producer.did.

cases.name: evidence_id_mismatch
cases.description: evidence_id is not the UUID v5 of the session and producer.

cases.name: acts_not_ordered
cases.description: The acts are not in sequence order.

cases.name: act_invalid
cases.description: An act's content no longer matches its act_hash.

cases.name: money_basis_invalid
cases.description: A money_basis no longer reproduces its claimed normalized total.

cases.name: line_items_invalid
cases.description: A recorded act states line-item money under the bare unit_price / total names.

cases.name: observed_responder_rules
cases.description: An observed responder's record claims a level other than unilateral.

cases.name: external_commitment_rules
cases.description: An external-channel record claims bilateral.

cases.name: accepted_responder_signed_act
cases.description: An acceptance names the counteroffer the responder signed.

cases.name: external_commitment_producer_act_missing
cases.description: An external-channel record in which no act of the initiator's is signed.

cases.name: external_commitment_not_sealed_by_initiator
cases.description: An external-channel record sealed by the responder, not the initiator.

cases.name: bilateral_witness_mismatch
cases.description: A transaction_record_hash witnesses a completion whose responder is an observed party.

cases.name: act_chain_hash_mismatch
cases.description: act_chain_hash does not recompute.

cases.name: evidence_level_mismatch
cases.description: evidence_level is not the level the acts give.

cases.name: record_hash_mismatch
cases.description: record_hash does not recompute.

cases.name: producer_signature_invalid
cases.description: producer_signature is not over record_hash.
